preview: In this episode, we look at personalized news feeds and the choices behind the stories they show. These feeds can make news easier to find, but they also raise questions about who shapes what a reader sees. By the end, you will understand why this question matters and what is still uncertain about the effect of these feeds on political views.
comment_1: As you listen, notice how one experience is viewed in two different ways.
comment_2: To explore this question, we will now hear different voices, one after another. Each person will share a personal view of the question.
comment_3: You have now heard two people describe the feed in different ways. Instead of asking which person is right, let’s ask why the same situation can feel different to each person. Next, we’ll look more closely at that question.
comment_4: So the question is not only who is right. A deeper question is: what makes this situation work the way it does, and how much of it can each person see?
